auth.heroHeadline: Every brother, every family, remembered on their day.
auth.heroSub: A private place for our lodge to keep birthdays and the small things that make each card personal.
auth.heroFoot: For brothers of the lodge and their families only.
auth.signInSub: Use the account the lodge created for you.
auth.forgotNote: Forgot your password, or no account yet? Accounts are created by the lodge superadmin. Ask the secretary to reset it for you.
auth.setupSub: Create the Lodge profile and the first administrator. The database is initialized automatically.
auth.changePasswordForced: You must set a new password before continuing.
auth.changePasswordSub: Choose a strong password of at least 10 characters.

home.title: Upcoming birthdays
home.leadOne: Brothers, their spouses and children. Showing the next {weeks} weeks, {count} birthday.
home.leadMany: Brothers, their spouses and children. Showing the next {weeks} weeks, {count} birthdays.
home.noNotesYet: No notes yet for the birthday card.
home.privacyNotice: Contact details and notes are private to this brother's family and the lodge officers.
home.emptyUpcoming: No birthdays match in the next {weeks} weeks.
home.noEvents: No upcoming lodge events scheduled in this window.
home.calloutTitle: Help the lodge find the right words
home.calloutBody: A line or two about each person goes a long way. Add what they love, what they just achieved, what they dream of.

family.title: My family
family.lead: Only you and the lodge officers can see this page. The notes you add are used to make each birthday card personal.
family.notesHint: What does {name} love, or what did they just achieve?
family.noNotesBox: No notes yet. A line or two is plenty.
family.placeholderSelf: e.g. Plays golf every Sunday, collects vinyl records
family.placeholderChild: e.g. Draws manga, just joined the school robotics team
family.bottomTitle: Add a spouse or child to your household
family.bottomBody: You can add your spouse and children directly below. Removing a family member from the register is handled by the lodge administrator.

brothers.title: Brothers
brothers.lead: The brothers of our lodge. Families are private to each brother and the lodge officers.
brothers.purgeWarning1: You are about to permanently delete {name} and {count} {familyWord}.
brothers.purgeWarning2: By deleting this member, ALL his information — his and his family's — is purged from the database as an action that cannot be reversed.

personView.noFamilyMembers: No family members on record for this brother.

admin.title: Lodge administration
admin.lead: Only the superadmin can create or remove brothers and family members, mark brothers as sleeping, and manage lodge events.
admin.tempPasswordHint: — share it once with the brother. It will not be shown again.
admin.createBrotherHint: A temporary password will be generated so he can sign in and set his own password.
admin.eventsLead: Events appear beside the birthday list for every brother.
admin.eventTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Regular meeting, Initiation of Bro. Silva
admin.categoriesSub: System categories (Initiation, Elevation, Exaltation, Wedding anniversary, Lodge anniversary, Other) are built in. You can add custom categories for your lodge below.
admin.windowSub: How far ahead brothers see upcoming birthdays by default.
admin.untilPreview: With {weeks} weeks, brothers will see birthdays up to {date}.
admin.identitySub: Displayed in the navigation bar, sign-in screen, and member relationship labels.
